items.title: Catanduvas (PR) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 10 #26
items.en_title: Catanduvas (PR) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 10 #26
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Catanduvas (PR) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 50,500; proposals close Dec 10, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
